hints.title: Boundary Verification
hints.text: An element is good if it exceeds both neighbor elements located exactly distance k away when they exist.

hints.title: Linear Sweep Condition
hints.text: Check whether index i - k is valid and whether index i + k is valid for each position i.

hints.title: Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate values that satisfy the condition into the running sum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Inspects at most 2 boundary neighbors per element in a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing boundary checks individually without constant time indexing adds unnecessary operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates condition in place using constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Performs boundary guards and adjacent checks cleanly in a single pass.
